$meta.author: Muse (UX Writer)

targets.codeBlock: BELL-Explain src/components/CodeBlock.tsx (lines 68-69, 77-80, 102-104 - code block header copy button, region landmark aria-labels with optional line highlight range, and manual copy fallback notice)
targets.relatedNotes: BELL-Explain src/components/RelatedNotes.tsx (lines 10, 19, 27-29 - section heading/landmark, relation tooltip composition, and show-remaining/collapse toggle) & src/lib/related-notes.ts (lines 13, 26, 34, 38 - RELATION_LABELS, parent/child follow-up reasons, and section backlink label)

placeholders.{language}: Programming language label passed to CodeBlock (defaults to 'javascript' in CodeBlock.tsx, or falls back to codeBlock.defaultLanguage when empty).
placeholders.{startLine}: 1-based starting line number of the active highlightRange in CodeBlock.tsx.
placeholders.{endLine}: 1-based ending line number of the active highlightRange in CodeBlock.tsx.
placeholders.{count}: Remaining relation item count (items.length - SHOWN, where SHOWN = 8) in RelatedNotes.tsx.
placeholders.{section}: Cleaned target step or section heading (leading step/section numbers stripped by cleanHeading()) in related-notes.ts.

budgets.layoutNote: At a 320px viewport, .code-header keeps its copy button icon-only (30px x 28px) with copyCode in aria-label and title, while .copy-error renders as a full-width block (9px font, 8px padding) where 'Select the code to copy it manually.' (36 chars) fits without horizontal overflow. In .related-notes (16px side margins below 600px, 16px horizontal padding = 256px inner width), collapse ('Show less', 9 chars <= 12-char budget) and showRemaining / showRemainingOne ('Show 2 more connections' / 'Show 1 more connection', 22-23 rendered chars at 11px font) stay on a single line.

rationale: Preserves all shipped Taiwanese zh-TW strings byte-for-byte from bell-explain-src 4cdc9b52 / 299f3a49 (src/components/CodeBlock.tsx, src/components/RelatedNotes.tsx, and src/lib/related-notes.ts) so existing UI snapshots and server/math-ui.test.ts plus server/learning-ui.test.ts remain non-regressing.

Aligns codeBlock.copyCode ('Copy code'), codeBlock.regionAria ('{language} code'), codeBlock.copyFallback ('Select the code to copy it manually.'), and relatedNotes.collapse ('Show less', 9 chars) with BELL-Explain's v3 learning glossary in src/copy/ui-strings.json.

Provides paired showRemaining and showRemainingOne keys with identical {count} placeholders across zh-TW and en so English renders grammatical singular ('Show 1 more connection') when items.length === 9 and plural ('Show {count} more connections') otherwise.

Uses directional, beginner-friendly English relation labels ('Further reading', 'Referenced by', 'Continues from', 'Continued in') and plain follow-up reasons so learners can immediately distinguish outbound links, inbound backlinks, parent notes, and child follow-ups in hover tooltips and Markdown exports.
Wraps {section} in typographic curly double quotes in en.relatedNotes.sectionBacklink to parallel zh-TW corner brackets.
assumptions: CodeBlock.tsx defaults language = 'javascript'; codeBlock.defaultLanguage ('Code' in en) applies when callers pass an empty language string. When language is empty under ?lang=en, callers formatting regionAria should avoid repeating 'Code code' (rendering defaultLanguage alone), whereas highlightRegionAria ('Code, highlighting lines {startLine} to {endLine}') interpolates defaultLanguage directly.

relatedNotes.labels uses camelCase keys (linksTo, linkedFrom, continues, continuedBy) mapping 1-to-1 to RelatedNote['kind'] values ('links-to', 'linked-from', 'continues', 'continued-by') in src/lib/related-notes.ts.
RelatedNotes.tsx renders default heading ('Related notes') when no title prop is passed; LessonV3Reader.tsx and LegacyNoteReader pass their own wrap-up heading ('Read next') via the title prop.

RelatedNotes.tsx joins [labels[item.kind], item.section, item.reason] with middle dots in each row button's title tooltip; LessonV3Reader.tsx Markdown export joins item.section and item.reason, which should use '; ' in English instead of a full-width semicolon.
